name: CD4060B
description: A 14-stage binary ripple counter with an on-chip oscillator (RC or crystal). Drives long time delays and frequency division from a single chip. Note that not every stage is brought out to a pin.

pins.name: CEXT
pins.description: external timing capacitor connection (Ct to GND in the RC oscillator circuit)

pins.name: REXT
pins.description: external timing resistor connection (Rt, per the datasheet's RC oscillator circuit)

pins.name: RS
pins.description: oscillator reset/enable input, gated together with MR; part of the RC oscillator startup network (small R2/C2 per the datasheet's oscillator circuit figure)

pins.name: RESET
pins.description: master reset, active HIGH; clears all stages and disables the oscillator

extra.stages: 14 (Q1-Q14, but only Q4-Q10 and Q12-Q14 pinned out)

typical_application: Long-period timers and frequency dividers: an RC or crystal oscillator on pins 9/10/11 feeds the divider chain; tap a Q output for the divided clock.
gotchas: stages Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q11 are NOT pinned out; only Q4-Q10 and Q12-Q14 are accessible
RESET is active HIGH; tie pin 12 LOW for normal counting

the RC oscillator network: timing capacitor (Ct) on pin 9 (CEXT), timing resistor (Rt) on pin 10 (REXT), and pin 11 (RS) carries a small R2/C2 startup network per the datasheet's own oscillator circuit figure; a high RESET also stops the oscillator
outputs are not in pin-number order; check the stage labels
